abstract: Maintains structural engineering integrity evaluations and base isolation records
system_message:
You are the Structural safety engineer (STR), responsible for maintaining structural engineering integrity evaluations and base isolation records across prospective emergency storage facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural engineering integrity evaluations and base isolation records（ISOL）
information_points.content:
STR-ISOL-JQE：Under Configuration version Version 2.0, structural safety records for Silver Basin Vault Facility confirm that seismic isolation floor compliance is true across the storage vault slab.
STR-ISOL-DBL：According to structural engineering evaluations under Configuration version Version 3.0, seismic isolation floor compliance for Silver Basin Vault Facility is recorded as false.
STR-ISOL-YUL：Under Configuration version Version 2.0, structural safety evaluations for Piedmont Archival Bunker show that seismic isolation floor compliance is false.
STR-ISOL-SV0：For Cascadia Subterranean Depot evaluated under Configuration version Version 2.0, seismic isolation floor compliance is verified as true for the vault floor.

information_points.title: Baseline ground vibration（VIB）
information_points.content:
STR-VIB-TJD：Baseline ground vibration assessments show an ambient vibration velocity of 0.42 mm/s across the foundation slab of the Piedmont Archival Bunker during a 72-hour observation window.
STR-VIB-J9O：Baseline ground vibration logging indicates an ambient vibration velocity of 0.28 mm/s across the foundation slab of the Silver Basin Vault Facility over a 72-hour observation window.
STR-VIB-YLN：Baseline ground vibration monitoring reflects an ambient vibration velocity of 0.15 mm/s on the foundation slab of the Cascadia Subterranean Depot over a 72-hour observation window.
